hooks.command: FILE=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")' 2>/dev/null) || { echo 'BLOCK: hook could not parse tool_input (python3 missing or malformed payload); refusing to fail open.' >&2; exit 2; }; [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.py$' || exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet "$FILE" || { echo "ruff hook: could not format $FILE. Is uv on PATH and the test extra synced (uv sync --extra test)?" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

FILE=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")' 2>/dev/null) || { echo 'BLOCK: hook could not parse tool_input (python3 missing or malformed payload); refusing to fail open.' >&2; exit 2; }; [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(tsx?|jsx?|css)$' || exit 0; case "$FILE" in */frontend/*|frontend/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; P="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier"; [ -x "$P" ] || { echo "prettier hook: $P not found. Run npm ci in frontend/." >&2; exit 2; }; "$P" --log-level warn --write "$FILE" || { echo "prettier hook: could not format $FILE" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

FILE=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")' 2>/dev/null) || { echo 'BLOCK: hook could not parse tool_input (python3 missing or malformed payload); refusing to fail open.' >&2; exit 2; }; [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ]; then REL=${FILE#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}; else REL=$FILE; fi; case "$REL" in .env.example|*/.env.example) exit 0;; esac; if echo "$REL" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env(\.[^/]+)?$|(^|/)\.envrc$|(^|/)uv\.lock$'; then echo "BLOCK: $REL is protected. .env files hold secrets and are never edited by an agent; uv.lock changes go through uv (uv lock / uv add)." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
